calls.title: Ashely + Rachel + Bryan chat Developer Advocate Role
calls.summary: The team clarified the Developer Advocate role, highlighting the importance of a technically skilled front-end advocate who balances coding with content creation to engage the developer community. Ashley emphasized the need for candidates to possess strong engineering skills, particularly in front-end development, while also being effective communicators who are comfortable in public speaking and content creation. The interview process prioritizes candidates who demonstrate both technical depth and community engagement experience, with a focus on a strategic plan for their first 12 months. Current challenges include increasing product awareness and stronger customer engagement, which the Developer Advocate role aims to address through clear tutorials and demos, helping to lower onboarding barriers and enhance developer retention.
calls.keywords: Developer Advocate, Front-end Development, Developer Relations, Feature Flags, Content Creation, Public Speaking
